card.name: Start of the word infusion
card.fires_on: The first piece "Inf" (or "inf") of the word infusion, when it is split into pieces. It appears in dosing tables and headings about IV infusion, bolus, and rates.

modes.label: Infusion in dosing tables
modes.description: "Inf" starting infusion in table headings or cells next to bolus, rate, or continuous.

modes.label: Infusion after a sentence break
modes.description: "Inf" opens the word at the start of a sentence or section label.
modes.example: (see next paragraph regarding flushing of tubing).<< Inf>>usion: With any intermittent infusion of az

modes.label: Re-infused
modes.description: Lowercase "inf" inside a longer form such as reinfused.
modes.example: the solution may be re<<inf>>used at a rate of 30

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word being continued as raw or hom-, and raises inf-like pieces, so it mostly marks that the next piece is "usion".
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of the word infusion when the word is broken into pieces in IV dosing text.
